o.text: Likely a semi-learned borrowing from Late Old Anatolian Turkish [script needed] (*toğu) that was only attested in compounds in the Ottoman translations of Quran into Old Anatolian Turkish since 1424. Otherwise, directly borrowed from Turkish doğu. Likely used since 1960s or 1980.
From Classical Persian محافظ (muhāfiz), from Arabic مُحَافِظ (muḥāfiẓ).

From Persian رد (radd), from Arabic رَدّ (radd). Rədd etmək parallels Persian رد کردن (radd kardan) and Armenian ռադ անել (ṙad anel). Rədd olmaq parallels Persian رد شدن (radd šodan) and Armenian ռադ լինել (ṙad linel).
Borrowed from Ancient Greek ὄργανον (órganon), likely via Russian о́рган (órgan).

Izafet II compound of ulduzlar + ara. Likely a calque of Russian межзвёздный (mežzvjózdnyj). Cognate with Turkish yıldızlararası, Turkmen ýyldyzlarara, Uzbek yulduzlararo, Kazakh жұлдызаралық (juldızaralıq), Kyrgyz жылдыздар аралык (jıldızdar aralık).
